translations.web: “After you, another kingdom will arise that is inferior to you; and another third kingdom of bronze, which will rule over all the earth.
translations.bsb: But after you, there will arise another kingdom, inferior to yours. Next, a third kingdom, one of bronze, will rule the whole earth.
translations.kjv: And after thee shall arise another kingdom inferior to thee, and another third kingdom of brass, which shall bear rule over all the earth.
